in_hebrew.name: Svetozar
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Star of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Svetozar הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Slavic roots, Svetozar translates to 'star of God'. This name carries a rich history and significance in Eastern European cultures, where it has been popular for centuries. Svetozar is often associated with strength, courage, and divine guidance.
